title: report.py stacks --output-mode json
description: One table of DNS provider stacks (dns_providers grouped by provider_id; a provider declaring none belongs to no stack and is left out), at most --limit rows. Support is a distribution over the stack's probed deployments, not an average (GitHub issue #160); supported_templates and their changes count templates any deployment supports, changes replayed over the full and weekly sweeps only (GitHub issues #219, #262); what the deployments' supported templates serve is summed (GitHub issue #281); domains describe the selected import, named in the note.

rows.description: Ordered by domains (descending) when a domain share is selected, otherwise by deployments descending. Empty when there are no DNS providers.

name.description: providerName of the stack's first deployment, falling back to the stack's providerId, then '?'.

provider_id.description: The stack's providerId (dns_providers.provider_id of its deployments).

deployments.description: dns_providers rows in the stack, probed or not.

domains.description: Sum of the deployments' domains in the selected import; null without a domain share or when no deployment has a measurement.

deploymentSupportPct.description: Over the stack's deployments with at least one answer (supported or not supported): supported / total templates, as a percentage. null when no deployment has an answer (GitHub issue #271).
